name: rust-modeler-mcp
description: Control the Rust 3D Modeler & Voxel Sculpt Studio via MCP: create primitives, edit polygonal meshes, sculpt with Dyntopo, apply volumetric SDF voxel brushes, and import/export OBJ, STL, and glTF 2.0.
suggestedPrompts: Launch the 3D Modeler GUI and build a stylized castle tower out of primitives and extrusions
Create a voxel clay sphere and sculpt a creature head using symmetry and Dyntopo brushes
Inspect the current 3D scene and export the model to scene.glb
